info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Accounts Retrieval API
info.description: The Settlement Accounts Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about settlement accounts within the system. This endpoint is essential for businesses engaged in financial transactions, offering insights into account balances and transaction histories. Typical consumers include financial analysts and accounting software, aiming to validate and reconcile financial data efficiently. By querying this API, users can ensure accurate settlement account management and maintain robust financial records.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific settlement account identified by the given account number. This includes all pertinent data such as account balance, account type, and associated transactions.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving settlement account operations. It contains the necessary parameters to filter and obtain relevant data regarding the specified settlement account.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the settlement account details.

GetSettlementAccountByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to settlement account with ID ACC-200045. It is expected to contain a string value.

settlementAccountId.description: Unique identifier for the settlement account.

merchantId.description: Unique identifier for the merchant associated with the settlement account.

account.description: Object representing the details of the bank account.

schedule.description: Object representing the schedule for the settlement account.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether this is the default settlement account.

verificationStatus.description: Current verification status of the settlement account.

status.description: Current status of the settlement account.

audit.description: Object containing audit information for the settlement account.

metadata.description: Object containing metadata related to the response.
